system.description:
Invoking this rune causes the blaring of ghostly horns which summon forth a hunting host from the wild woods of Fairy. You direct them to chase a specific quarry of your choosing.

The hunting host consists of 4d6 fairy hounds, 2d20 elf hunters on foot, 2d20 elf hunters mounted on fairy horses, and 1d6 goblin horn blowers.
